_about: P2-1 manual touches, part 2 of 2: run with Send-Suite -Fresh after parking-touches-save.json. Loads the city with the hand-edited car park in a fresh game and lists every group record with the hand edits its receipt kept (they must be the same as after the rebuild), then a picture of the lot. The save is deleted at the end. Send with: powershell -File tools/suite/Send-Suite.ps1 -File suite/scenarios/parking-touches-load.json -Fresh -Who p2-parking-tools
